results.ao_statement: APPROVAL FOR TWO ELECTRICAL DESIGN CHANGES FOR THE LIFEVEST WEARABLEDEFIBRILLATOR 4000 MONITOR PULSE DELIVERY CIRCUITRY. THESE CHANGES INCLUDE AND INCREASE THE VALUES OF FOUR DC BLOCKING CAPACITORS ON THE DEFIBRILLATOR PCA AND TWO BULK CAPACITORS ON THE MONITOR COMPUTER/ANALOG (C/A) BOARD, AS WELL AS CHANGE THE DC BLOCKING CAPACITOR DIELECTRIC FROM Y5V TO X7R AND THE ADDITION OF FERRITE BEAD TO THE BATTERY POWER WIRE ON THE C/A BOARD. THE DEVICE, AS MODIFIED, WILL BE MARKETED UNDER THE TRADE NAME LIFEVEST WEARABLE DEFIBRILLATOR 4000 AND IS INDICATED FOR ADULT PATIENTSWHO ARE AT RISK FOR SUDDEN CARDIAC ARREST AND ARE NOT CANDIDATES FOR OR REFUSE AN IMPLANTABLE DEFIBRILLATOR.
ADDITION OF AN ALTERNATE SUPPLIER, CARCLO TECHNICAL PLASTICS (CTP) LATROBE, PA, FOR THE THERAPY ELECTRODE GEL BLISTER COVER.
ALTERNATE SUPPLIER, SUN STAR, INC., IN LATROBE, PENNSYLVANIA FOR THE ECG BACKCOVER WITH RETAINER DUAL AND ECG BACK COVER WITH RETAINER SINGLE.

Approval for the HWD 1000 System. This is a wearable defibrillation for hospital use that is based on the previously approved LifeVest Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (WCD) 4000 design as a platform and incorporates design features from the previously approved WCD 3000S.
APPROVAL FOR AN ALTERNATE GEL FIRE POWER SWITCH AND HIGHER CAPACITYSD CARD ON THE LIFEVEST MODEL 4000.
ADDITION OF A NEW, OPTIONAL DISPENSING EQUIPMENT USED IN THE THERAPY ELECTRODE MANUFACTURING PROCESS.
Approval for modifications to the Charger/Modem power supply cable.
AN ADDITIONAL, PRE-APPROVED SUPPLIER OF A CUSTOM COMPONENT TO BE USED AS PART OF THE DEVICE IN CONSIDERATION.
Approval for modifications to the currently approved garment.
Approval for modifications to current software (bug fixes, improvements, background noise detection feature).

Approval for a larger capacity battery pack and associated modifications to the battery pack connection to the printed circuit assembly (PCA) for the WCD 4000 System.  This device is indicated for patients of all ages who are at risk for sudden cardiac arrest and either not candidates for or refuse an implantable defibrillator.
Specification of a temperature controlled heat gun to be used in the LifeVest 4000 Electrode Belt Subassembly procedure.
